global_rules.figure: full-body person — head to feet visible, diverse cast per choice
global_rules.style: flat vector illustration, unDraw-inspired, thin 2px #2D2D2D outline on figure and props
global_rules.face: minimal friendly face — simple dot eyes, small mouth optional, not photorealistic
global_rules.background: fully transparent PNG — no white fill, no floor box; optional thin grey ground line only
global_rules.locale: neutral global — young adult student age

style_reference_notes.from_1_1: Side-profile full body, purple top + dark pants, interacting with activity prop (robot), light grey accent blobs, thin floor line
style_reference_notes.from_1_2: Standing full body, purple/lavender top + black wide pants, holding activity prop (document/chart), abstract background shapes
style_reference_notes.shared: Flat fills, thin outline, limited palette, generous negative space, symbol icons OK (checkmark, exclamation) but no words

color_rule: KursoKo purple #4B2C7F as base garment accent + subtle RIASEC code accent on props or trim
